translations.web: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
translations.bsb: Without clothing, they wander about naked. They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
translations.kjv: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
translations.asv: So that they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves.
